label: Revenue
purpose: Top-line growth tracking and the base for every margin.
formula: Sum of GL revenue recognized in the month (usage 4000 + project services 4100).
tolerance: Usage must equal rated usage (recon_gl_revenue); services must equal project invoices (recon_project_billing_gl).
numerator: GL revenue accounts 4000 + 4010 + 4100
inclusions: Usage, refunds and credits, project services
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: variance vs budget; higher is better; amber at -0.05, red at -0.15

label: Cost of revenue
purpose: Gross margin and cost-to-serve trend.
formula: Sum of GL COGS accounts (5000 GPU, 5010 cloud hosting, 5100 payment processing, 5200/5210 project subcontractors and direct costs).
tolerance: Vendor invoices reconcile to modeled cost within 1% (recon_vendor_invoices).
numerator: GL COGS accounts 5000-5210
inclusions: GPU, cloud hosting, payment processing, project subcontractors and direct costs
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: variance vs budget; lower is better; amber at -0.05, red at -0.15

label: Operating expenses
purpose: Spending pace by department; input to BvA (M5).
formula: Sum of GL operating expense accounts (6000–6500).
tolerance: Payroll accounts equal the payroll register exactly (recon_payroll_gl).
numerator: GL opex accounts 6000-6600
inclusions: Payroll, cloud R&D, software, rent, professional fees, marketing, depreciation
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: variance vs budget; lower is better; amber at -0.05, red at -0.1

label: Gross margin %
purpose: Pricing and product mix decisions.
formula: (Revenue − COGS) ÷ Revenue, from the GL.
tolerance: GL-based; differs from fct_unit_economics_monthly, which allocates modeled cost and excludes payment fees.
numerator: revenue - cogs
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 0.62, red at 0.55

label: Gross burn
purpose: Spending pace in cash terms.
formula: Operating cash out (GL cash account 1000, excluding financing).
tolerance: Closing cash must never be negative.
numerator: Cash paid out in the month (credits to account 1000)
exclusions: Intercompany settlements (net to zero across entities)
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: month-over-month change; lower is better; amber at 0.05, red at 0.15

label: Net burn
purpose: How fast the company consumes cash; drives runway.
formula: Operating cash out − operating cash in. Positive = burning.
tolerance: None beyond GL balance.
numerator: Cash out - cash in, excluding equity raised
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: month-over-month change; lower is better; amber at 0.1, red at 0.3

label: Cash balance
purpose: Liquidity and fundraising timing.
formula: Cumulative net change in GL cash (account 1000) to month end.
tolerance: Will reconcile to Stripe payouts and bank statements in M12.
numerator: Balance of account 1000 at month end, all entities
inclusions: Operating bank, money market, T-bills (one GL account)
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 9000000, red at 6000000

label: Runway
purpose: Fundraising timing.
formula: Closing cash ÷ average net burn over the trailing 3 months. Blank when not burning or under 3 months of history.
tolerance: Assumes the trailing burn rate continues; not a forecast.
numerator: closing_cash
exclusions: Planned raises (see the scenario engine for runway with financing)
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 24, red at 15

label: Run-rate ARR
purpose: Growth tracking on an annualized basis.
formula: Recognized usage revenue in the month x 12. A run rate, not contracted ARR (see contracted_arr) and not GAAP revenue.
tolerance: Usage-based ARR moves with seasonality; read with NRR.
numerator: Recognized usage revenue in the month x 12
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: month-over-month change; higher is better; amber at 0.0, red at -0.02

label: Headcount
purpose: Hiring plan tracking and per-employee ratios.
formula: Employees hired on or before month end and not yet terminated.
tolerance: Employees with pay in the month must reconcile to headcount ± hires and leavers.
numerator: Employees on payroll at month end, all entities
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: variance vs plan; lower is better; amber at 0.02, red at 0.05

label: ARR per employee
purpose: Efficiency benchmark (FR-4.3 revenue per employee, on an annualized basis).
formula: ARR ÷ month-end headcount.
tolerance: None.
numerator: arr
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 250000, red at 180000

label: Net revenue retention
purpose: Expansion health of the existing customer base.
formula: Trailing-3-month revenue now from customers who had revenue in the same window 12 months earlier ÷ their revenue then.
tolerance: Starts once 12 months plus a 3-month window of history exist.
numerator: Revenue this month from customers active 12 months ago
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 1.1, red at 1.0

label: Gross revenue retention
purpose: Churn and contraction, with expansion removed.
formula: Same cohort as NRR, but each customer's current revenue is capped at its prior revenue.
tolerance: Always ≤ NRR and ≤ 1.
numerator: Revenue this month from customers active 12 months ago, each capped at its revenue then
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 0.9, red at 0.85

label: Active customers
purpose: Size of the paying base; denominator for churn.
formula: Customers with usage revenue in the month.
tolerance: Equals opening + new + reactivated − churned (assert_mrr_bridge_balances).
numerator: Customers with revenue in the month
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: month-over-month change; higher is better; amber at 0.0, red at -0.03

label: New customers
purpose: Acquisition pace.
formula: Customers with revenue this month and none in any earlier month.
tolerance: None.
numerator: Customers whose first revenue month is this month
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 3, red at 1

label: Churned customers
purpose: Retention problems by count; read with the churn reasons.
formula: Customers with revenue last month and none this month. Mid-month churn shows the month after.
tolerance: Measured from revenue; a customer that pauses for a month counts as churned, then reactivated.
numerator: Customers with revenue last month and none this month
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 2, red at 4

label: Logo churn rate
purpose: Share of paying customers lost each month; drives retention priorities.
formula: Churned customers ÷ customers with revenue last month.
tolerance: Dominated by self-serve; read alongside gross MRR churn.
numerator: churned_customers
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 0.03, red at 0.05

label: Gross MRR churn rate
purpose: Revenue lost from existing customers each month, before expansion.
formula: −(contraction MRR + churned MRR) ÷ opening MRR.
tolerance: Usage noise makes every month show some contraction; trend matters more than level.
numerator: Revenue lost from churned customers
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 0.02, red at 0.04

label: DSO
purpose: How fast customers pay; cash planning and collections staffing.
formula: Ending AR ÷ invoiced sales in the month × days in the month.
tolerance: AR subledger must equal the GL control account (assert_ar_ties_to_gl). Month-end billing makes it swing.
numerator: Ending AR
denominator: Invoiced sales in the month x days in the month
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 50, red at 65

label: Collection effectiveness index
purpose: Collections team performance, independent of sales volume.
formula: (Beginning AR + sales − ending AR) ÷ (beginning AR + sales − ending current AR).
tolerance: 1.0 means everything collectible was collected.
numerator: Beginning AR + sales - ending AR
denominator: Beginning AR + sales - ending current AR
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 0.85, red at 0.75

label: AR over 60 days
purpose: Bad-debt risk and write-off candidates.
formula: Open invoice balances more than 60 days past due at month end.
tolerance: Includes failed-payment self-serve balances that should be reviewed for write-off.
numerator: Open invoice balances more than 60 days past due
exclusions: Disputed invoices are included and flagged
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 25000, red at 100000

label: Net new run-rate ARR
purpose: Growth quality: where ARR came from and went.
formula: (new + expansion + reactivation + contraction + churn) MRR x 12
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: (new + expansion + reactivation + contraction + churn) MRR x 12
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 500000, red at 0

label: SaaS quick ratio
purpose: Is growth efficient: ARR added per ARR lost.
formula: (new + expansion + reactivation) / |contraction + churn|, trailing 3 months
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: (new + expansion + reactivation) / |contraction + churn|, trailing 3 months
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 4, red at 2

label: Burn multiple
purpose: Capital efficiency: cash burned per dollar of net new ARR.
formula: net burn / net new ARR, trailing 3 months; null when net new ARR is not positive
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: net burn / net new ARR, trailing 3 months; null when net new ARR is not positive
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 1.5, red at 2.0

label: Rule of 40
purpose: Balance of growth and profitability.
formula: revenue growth year on year + EBITDA margin
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: revenue growth year on year + EBITDA margin
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.
period_logic: Closed months only; a month closes when it is billed on the 1st of the next month.
refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 0.4, red at 0.2

label: CAC (S&M only)
purpose: Cost to acquire a customer.
formula: Sales department opex / new customers, trailing 3 months
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: Sales department opex / new customers, trailing 3 months
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.

threshold_rule: month-over-month change; lower is better; amber at 0.1, red at 0.25

label: CAC (fully burdened)
purpose: Unit economics without hidden overhead.
formula: (Sales opex + Sales' headcount share of G&A) / new customers, trailing 3 months
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: (Sales opex + Sales' headcount share of G&A) / new customers, trailing 3 months
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.

threshold_rule: month-over-month change; lower is better; amber at 0.1, red at 0.25

label: LTV : CAC (fully burdened)
purpose: Is acquisition creating value.
formula: ARPA x gross margin / monthly logo churn, over burdened CAC
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: ARPA x gross margin / monthly logo churn, over burdened CAC
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.

restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; higher is better; amber at 3.0, red at 1.5

label: CAC payback (fully burdened)
purpose: How long to earn back acquisition cost.
formula: burdened CAC / (ARPA x gross margin)
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
numerator: burdened CAC / (ARPA x gross margin)
currency_treatment: USD as booked. Foreign-currency invoices are converted at the invoice date's rate; currency moves on collection go to realized FX, not this metric.

refresh: Daily (morning run); final at month close
restatement_policy: Closed months are not restated; corrections post in the open month and are disclosed in the board pack
threshold_rule: value; lower is better; amber at 12, red at 18

label: Magic number
purpose: Sales efficiency: new revenue per S&M dollar.
formula: (revenue this quarter - revenue last quarter) x 4 / S&M spend last quarter
tolerance: Recomputed from governed marts; parity-tested on two engines.
